name: VCU100 — Português Brasileiro para Turismo

language_info.name_ja: ポルトガル語（ブラジル）

notes: 176 context-marked Brazilian Portuguese tourism terms and phrases, plus American English interpretation.
Terms from Rio, Northeast, São Paulo and South marked by region where relevant.
English companion needed for native English paired cards.
